assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key-area polygons are provisional (geometry_role=provisional_constraint) until the organizer releases official polygons.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, and metrics must be recalculated from official geometry when it is released; provisional values are not precise-area bases.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio, and setback values are not proposed; they are marked pending official regulatory conditions.
assumptions.impact: No statutory intensity conclusion is claimed; concept density indicators (building_density) are conceptual references only.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios, landmarks, events, and operations are conceptual suggestions subject to human and professional review.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is described as approved operation or government arrangement; each card defines privacy boundary, human review, and operator.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are schematic placeholders for spatial discussion, not survey-accurate footprints.
assumptions.impact: Building density and footprint area are concept references; official survey data is required for formal values.
